values.note: 'Sites are available on a first come, first serve basis. Reservations are NOT available.' 'A 7 (SEVEN) day stay limit is strictly enforced.' Camping only in developed sites.
No camping fee posted; 'Donations are greatly appreciated. Donation pipes are available at two different sites in the campground.'
Restrooms on site (seasonal availability); trash receptacles; fire rings at every site; public boat ramp at the southeast end.

facilities.source: https://www.townofcolumbus.com/community/parks-and-recreation/ ('Restrooms are on-site (seasonal availability)', 'All sites are equipped with fire rings', 'A public boat ramp is located at the southeast end of the campground'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Columbus park on the banks of the Yellowstone River just south of town off MT-78, in two sections: Upper (near the bridge) and Lower (with the public boat ramp). Tents, camper trailers and RVs. --Claude
summary: City page: confirmed first-come only (no reservations), 7-day limit, donation-only camping ($0), restrooms (seasonal), boat ramp. Not stated: site count (the city's 2026 maps show roughly 28 Upper + 13 Lower site icons, too rough to replace the derived 30), drinking water (derived, left), toilet type, rig length, season.
